title: Content calendar
audience: For creators, marketers and founders who post every week.
description: An idea bank and a calendar. Ask your AI to plan the next two weeks from your ideas, and tell it when a post goes out.
tagline: What goes out when, and a bank of ideas.
note:
Content calendar

What's going out, where and when, plus a bank of ideas so you never start from a blank page. Tell your AI an idea to add the first.

## Calendar
<!-- pane-table: Publish on=text; Title=text; Channel=choice Blog|Newsletter|LinkedIn|Instagram|YouTube; Status=choice Idea|Drafting|Scheduled|Published -->
| Publish on | Title | Channel | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Ideas
Anything worth a post, added the moment you think of it.

## Voice
- Short sentences. One idea per post.
- Show the work: a screenshot or a number beats an adjective.
- End with a question, not a sales pitch.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Content calendar". Read it with fetch before each change. When I have an idea, add it under "Ideas" as a bullet with edit. When I ask you to plan the next two weeks, pick ideas from "Ideas" and add a row per post to the table with edit: Publish on as a date, a working Title, the Channel and Status Drafting. Write drafts in the tone described under "Voice". When I say a post went out, set its Status to Published.

asks: Ask for my content idea and where it should go, then add it to the idea bank.
Plan the next two weeks: two LinkedIn posts and one newsletter.
